subject: Message from Bobbie Zenker
labels: Opérations/🌱 Problème germination bombes ou graines ❗

messages.text: Yea, hey. Sorry for the bad PR. My partner and I have a small homestead in E. WA, about 8 acres in the hills. We actively farm about 3, where also have our home, a polebarn shop, home & greenhouse. We grow a variety of flowers & veggies. I am also a photogrpher. You can see my work on my profile page & at https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100075861670817.

You can imagine how excited I was to see your ad on FB. I was excited to be part of your mission to help endangered Monarch butterflies, and perhaps photograph them. As soon as I has some extra cash, I ordered the milkweed bombs I thought would be bet for our area. [Showy & Narrowleaf] Our soil is not that good - mostly clay, though we have been improving it with organic dirt and compost the last three years. There were no instructions included with the shipment, so I had to guess how best to plant.

I planted them shallow and covered them lightly with the same compost that we have used for all our starts (with great success), then patted lightly. WE have been very dry this summer, as you may know, so we have ket every thing well watered. I did not get so much as a sprout from the bombs - I mean nothing at all. Very disappointing.
